issues.what: the green interior and glass end together at a thin pale lip, with no visible recess or contact shadow to seat the globe
issues.fix: let a recessed collar overlap the glass edge and add a narrow contact shadow immediately below it

issues.where: crop 5, the foreground mist over the pond and ground
issues.what: the bright green mist reads as one soft band laid over the entire foreground and stops cleanly at the rim, even though the pond behind it has convincing ripples
issues.fix: vary the height and density of the wisps, let nearby grass and stones occlude some of them, and bend and fade the mist through the glass near the rim

issues.where: crops 2 and 3, the pumpkin faces on the base
issues.what: the bright eyes and teeth read as flat emissive shapes on dark shells; there is little visible cut depth or warm spill onto the nearest vines and base
issues.fix: give the cutouts visible inner walls and let the warm interior light graze the openings and nearby surfaces

issues.where: crop 7, the amber particles just inside the upper-right glass
issues.what: several large amber discs have uniform flat interiors and abruptly defined edges, so they look stamped over the much softer field of small lights
issues.fix: assign the large particles different depths and defocus them accordingly; soften their edges and vary their brightness across each disc

issues.what: the secondary white highlight ends in a sharply pinched bright tip and reads like an opaque stripe over the miniature rather than a reflection on the glass
issues.fix: soften the highlight falloff and let its intensity change with the curvature while retaining the separate thin outer glass edge

issues.where: crop 8, the orange leaves on the tabletop just to the right of the base
issues.what: several of the sharper folded leaves have no visible contact darkening or local reflection where their tips should touch, making them look suspended just above the surface
issues.fix: give the settled leaves a few distinct contact points with tight shadows and faint reflections, and reserve the unsupported silhouettes for airborne leaves
